title: Medieval manuscripts are "biological time capsules" for deadly sheeppox virus
summary: Other archives and libraries around the world may also contain genetic traces of past disease outbreaks.
llm_summary: Researchers have discovered that the parchment in medieval manuscripts can preserve viral DNA, effectively turning centuries‑old books into “biological time capsules” that still contain traces of the deadly sheeppox virus.
